App.Name: Indy Dice Stats
App.Subtitle: Track roll distributions by player, action, and die type.

Controls.PlayerHint: Choose which player's stats to view.
Controls.CompareHint: Select additional players to compare against the chosen player.
Controls.ActionHint: Filter stats by roll action type.
Controls.DetailHint: Filter saving throws, ability checks, or skill checks.
Controls.DieHint: Filter stats by die type (d4, d6, d20, etc.).
Controls.SessionHint: Filter stats to a specific day or all time.

Charts.NormalizeHint: Normalize comparisons by percent instead of raw counts.
Charts.CandlesHint: Show candlestick ranges on the trend view.
Charts.CycleHint: Click to toggle distribution, trend, and streaks view.

Table.SelectPlayers: Select two or more players to compare.

Reset.Title: Reset Dice Stats
Reset.Description: Clear stored stats for a player or for everyone.
Reset.ConfirmAll: This clears stats for every player. Continue?
Reset.ConfirmPlayer: This clears stored stats for the selected player. Continue?

Visibility.Title: Player Visibility
Visibility.Description: Select players to hide from the dice stats dashboard.
Visibility.ReshowHint: Uncheck a player and save to show them again.

Faker.Title: Generate Fake Data
Faker.Description: Create 12 sessions of sample rolls for testing.
Faker.Note: Generates 30–90 rolls per session across common roll types, checks, and saves. Existing stats are not cleared.
Faker.Confirm: Add fake dice stats for {name} across {sessions} sessions ({min}–{max} rolls each). Existing stats are not cleared. Continue?
Faker.Complete: Indy Dice Stats | Added {rolls} fake rolls across {sessions} sessions for {name}.

Enabled.Name: Enable dice tracking
Enabled.Hint: Track dice rolls for D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, and Midi-QOL workflows.

RestrictToGm.Name: Restrict module to GM
RestrictToGm.Hint: Totally disable Indy Dice Stats for non-GM users.

RecordSelf.Name: Record Self Rolls
RecordSelf.Hint: Record self-only rolls (private) in the dice stats.

RecordGmPrivate.Name: Record Private GM Rolls
RecordGmPrivate.Hint: Record GM private rolls in the dice stats.

RecordGmBlind.Name: Record Blind GM Rolls
RecordGmBlind.Hint: Record GM blind rolls in the dice stats.

AllowGmStats.Name: Allow Players to See GM Stats
AllowGmStats.Hint: Allow non-GM users to include GM stats in player lists and All Players views.

ShowActorNames.Name: Show Actor Names to Players
ShowActorNames.Hint: Display actor names in the Latest Roll monitor for non-GM users.

ShowLatest.Name: Show Latest Roll
ShowLatest.Hint: Display the latest roll in the dashboard title and floating monitor.

OnlyD20.Name: Only Monitor d20
OnlyD20.Hint: Only update the latest roll display when a roll includes a d20.

DebugMidi.Name: Debug Midi-QOL Roll Capture
DebugMidi.Hint: Log Midi-QOL roll sources and deduping details to the console.

RollDelay.Name: Roll Processing Delay (ms)
RollDelay.Hint: Delay processing chat and Midi-QOL rolls. When Dice So Nice is active, processing waits for its completion hook instead of this delay.

BodyFont.Name: Body Font
BodyFont.Hint: Font used for general text in the module.

TitleFont.Name: Title Font
TitleFont.Hint: Font used for titles and large numbers.

BodyScale.Name: Body Font Scale
BodyScale.Hint: Multiplier applied to body font sizes (e.g. 1.1 = 10% larger).

TitleScale.Name: Title Font Scale
TitleScale.Hint: Multiplier applied to title/number font sizes.

ChartScale.Name: Chart Legend Font Scale
ChartScale.Hint: Multiplier applied to chart legend and axis label sizes.

Viewer.Label: Open Dice Dashboard
Viewer.Hint: View dice statistics for players and actions.

Visibility.Label: Configure Hidden Players
Visibility.Hint: Choose players to hide from the dice stats dashboard.

Faker.Hint: Create fake dice stats for a selected player.
